viewof luv_lab_Lstar = Inputs.range([30, 85], {
  value: 65,
  step: 5,
  label: "Lightness L*"
})

viewof luv_lab_preset = Inputs.select(
  [
    { name: "Neutral (D65 white)", a: 0, b: 0 },
    { name: "Red-orange", a: 45, b: 35 },
    { name: "Yellow-green", a: -20, b: 50 },
    { name: "Green", a: -45, b: 25 },
    { name: "Cyan", a: -30, b: -20 },
    { name: "Blue", a: 15, b: -50 },
    { name: "Magenta", a: 45, b: -30 }
  ],
  {
    label: "Test light",
    format: d => d.name,
    value: { name: "Red-orange", a: 45, b: 35 }
  }
)

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
luv_lab_calc = {
  const Xn = 95.047, Yn = 100.0, Zn = 108.883;
  const denom_n = Xn + 15 * Yn + 3 * Zn;
  const un = (4 * Xn) / denom_n;
  const vn = (9 * Yn) / denom_n;
  const delta = 6 / 29;

  function finv(t) {
    return t > delta ? t * t * t : 3 * delta * delta * (t - 4 / 29);
  }

  function lab2xyz(L, a, b) {
    const fy = (L + 16) / 116;
    const fx = a / 500 + fy;
    const fz = fy - b / 200;
    return [
      Math.max(0, Xn * finv(fx)),
      Math.max(0, Yn * finv(fy)),
      Math.max(0, Zn * finv(fz))
    ];
  }

  function xyz2uv(X, Y, Z) {
    const d = X + 15 * Y + 3 * Z;
    if (d <= 0) return [0, 0];
    return [(4 * X) / d, (9 * Y) / d];
  }

  function lab2luv(L, a, b) {
    const [X, Y, Z] = lab2xyz(L, a, b);
    const [up, vp] = xyz2uv(X, Y, Z);
    return [13 * L * (up - un), 13 * L * (vp - vn)];
  }

  // Approximate display color for a (L, a, b) point (for visual cue only)
  function lab2css(L, a, b) {
    const [X, Y, Z] = lab2xyz(L, a, b);
    const x = X / 100, y = Y / 100, z = Z / 100;
    let r =  3.2406 * x - 1.5372 * y - 0.4986 * z;
    let g = -0.9689 * x + 1.8758 * y + 0.0415 * z;
    let bl = 0.0557 * x - 0.2040 * y + 1.0570 * z;
    const compand = c => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, c));
      return clamped <= 0.0031308 ? 12.92 * clamped : 1.055 * Math.pow(clamped, 1 / 2.4) - 0.055;
    };
    return `rgb(${Math.round(compand(r)*255)}, ${Math.round(compand(g)*255)}, ${Math.round(compand(bl)*255)})`;
  }

  const L = luv_lab_Lstar;
  const radius = 15;
  const a0 = luv_lab_preset.a;
  const b0 = luv_lab_preset.b;
  const [u0, v0] = lab2luv(L, a0, b0);

  const circlePts = [];
  const refUvPts = [];
  let minDEuv = Infinity;
  let maxDEuv = 0;

  const N = 72;
  for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
    const theta = (2 * Math.PI * i) / N;
    const a = a0 + radius * Math.cos(theta);
    const b = b0 + radius * Math.sin(theta);
    const [u, v] = lab2luv(L, a, b);
    const dEuv = Math.hypot(u - u0, v - v0);
    if (i < N) {
      if (dEuv < minDEuv) minDEuv = dEuv;
      if (dEuv > maxDEuv) maxDEuv = dEuv;
    }
    circlePts.push({ i, a, b, u, v, dEuv, color: lab2css(L, a, b) });
    refUvPts.push({
      i,
      u: u0 + radius * Math.cos(theta),
      v: v0 + radius * Math.sin(theta)
    });
  }

  // Constant-a* and constant-b* grid lines to show nonlinear warp
  const gridLines = [];
  const vals = [-60, -30, 0, 30, 60];
  for (const av of vals) {
    for (let bv = -60; bv <= 60; bv += 5) {
      const [u, v] = lab2luv(L, av, bv);
      gridLines.push({ series: `a=${av}`, a: av, b: bv, u, v });
    }
  }
  for (const bv of vals) {
    for (let av = -60; av <= 60; av += 5) {
      const [u, v] = lab2luv(L, av, bv);
      gridLines.push({ series: `b=${bv}`, a: av, b: bv, u, v });
    }
  }

  return {
    L,
    radius,
    a0,
    b0,
    u0,
    v0,
    centerColor: lab2css(L, a0, b0),
    circlePts,
    refUvPts,
    gridLines,
    minDEuv,
    maxDEuv
  };
}
```

//| echo: false
html`<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(290px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; align-items: start;">
  <div>
    ${Plot.plot({
      title: `CIELAB (a*, b*) at L* = ${luv_lab_calc.L}`,
      width: 360,
      height: 360,
      aspectRatio: 1,
      marginLeft: 48,
      marginBottom: 42,
      x: { label: "a* (red–green)", domain: [-90, 90] },
      y: { label: "b* (yellow–blue)", domain: [-90, 90] },
      marks: [
        Plot.gridX({ strokeOpacity: 0.15 }),
        Plot.gridY({ strokeOpacity: 0.15 }),
        Plot.ruleX([0], { stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "3,3" }),
        Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "3,3" }),
        Plot.line(luv_lab_calc.gridLines, {
          x: "a",
          y: "b",
          z: "series",
          stroke: "#cfd8dc",
          strokeWidth: 1
        }),
        Plot.line(luv_lab_calc.circlePts, {
          x: "a",
          y: "b",
          stroke: "#1f2937",
          strokeWidth: 2.2
        }),
        Plot.dot([{ a: luv_lab_calc.a0, b: luv_lab_calc.b0, c: luv_lab_calc.centerColor }], {
          x: "a",
          y: "b",
          r: 6,
          fill: "c",
          stroke: "#111",
          strokeWidth: 1.5
        })
      ]
    })}
  </div>
  <div>
    ${Plot.plot({
      title: `CIELUV (u*, v*) at L* = ${luv_lab_calc.L}`,
      width: 360,
      height: 360,
      aspectRatio: 1,
      marginLeft: 48,
      marginBottom: 42,
      x: { label: "u*", domain: [-110, 110] },
      y: { label: "v*", domain: [-110, 110] },
      marks: [
        Plot.gridX({ strokeOpacity: 0.15 }),
        Plot.gridY({ strokeOpacity: 0.15 }),
        Plot.ruleX([0], { stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "3,3" }),
        Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "3,3" }),
        Plot.line(luv_lab_calc.gridLines, {
          x: "u",
          y: "v",
          z: "series",
          stroke: "#cfd8dc",
          strokeWidth: 1
        }),
        Plot.line(luv_lab_calc.refUvPts, {
          x: "u",
          y: "v",
          stroke: "#64748b",
          strokeDasharray: "4,4",
          strokeWidth: 1.5
        }),
        Plot.line(luv_lab_calc.circlePts, {
          x: "u",
          y: "v",
          stroke: "#b91c1c",
          strokeWidth: 2.2
        }),
        Plot.dot([{ u: luv_lab_calc.u0, v: luv_lab_calc.v0, c: luv_lab_calc.centerColor }], {
          x: "u",
          y: "v",
          r: 6,
          fill: "c",
          stroke: "#111",
          strokeWidth: 1.5
        })
      ]
    })}
  </div>
</div>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #374151;">
  <strong>Selected test light (${luv_lab_preset.name}):</strong>
  (a*, b*) = (${luv_lab_calc.a0.toFixed(0)}, ${luv_lab_calc.b0.toFixed(0)})
  &rarr; (u*, v*) = (${luv_lab_calc.u0.toFixed(1)}, ${luv_lab_calc.v0.toFixed(1)}).
  Around the constant &Delta;E*<sub>ab</sub> = 15 circle (solid), &Delta;E*<sub>uv</sub> ranges from
  <strong>${luv_lab_calc.minDEuv.toFixed(1)}</strong> to <strong>${luv_lab_calc.maxDEuv.toFixed(1)}</strong>
  (dashed circle shows &Delta;E*<sub>uv</sub> = 15).
</p>`
